description: Source-bound decision, policy, approval, effect, outcome, and correction vocabulary for governed Rhize projections.

nodeSubtypes.name: Decision
nodeSubtypes.queryJustification: Reconstruct one consequential decision from current canonical evidence.

nodeSubtypes.name: DecisionEvent
nodeSubtypes.queryJustification: Verify the append-only lifecycle and optimistic-concurrency history of a decision.

nodeSubtypes.name: EvidenceSet
nodeSubtypes.queryJustification: Return the immutable evidence selection available when a decision was made.

nodeSubtypes.name: PolicySnapshot
nodeSubtypes.queryJustification: Resolve the exact policy version and digest governing a decision.

nodeSubtypes.name: PolicyEvaluation
nodeSubtypes.queryJustification: Reproduce a deterministic policy result from allowlisted input digests.

nodeSubtypes.name: Approval
nodeSubtypes.queryJustification: Verify the source-bound authority and expiry used to record a decision.

nodeSubtypes.name: Effect
nodeSubtypes.queryJustification: Distinguish an attempted external effect from its later observed outcome.

nodeSubtypes.name: OutcomeObservation
nodeSubtypes.queryJustification: Trace an authoritative later observation without rewriting the original decision.

nodeSubtypes.name: DecisionCorrection
nodeSubtypes.queryJustification: Preserve an approved correction, invalidation, reversal, or supersession.

relationshipTypes.name: BASED_ON
relationshipTypes.queryJustification: Return the evidence selection used by a decision.

relationshipTypes.name: GOVERNED_BY
relationshipTypes.queryJustification: Return the immutable policy snapshot governing a decision.

relationshipTypes.name: EVALUATED_AS
relationshipTypes.queryJustification: Reproduce the recorded policy result separately from approval.

relationshipTypes.name: AUTHORIZED_BY
relationshipTypes.queryJustification: Verify that a decision was recorded under current source-bound authority.

relationshipTypes.name: ATTEMPTED_EFFECT
relationshipTypes.queryJustification: Find external attempts without treating an attempt as success.

relationshipTypes.name: OBSERVED_OUTCOME
relationshipTypes.queryJustification: Return later authoritative outcomes separately from attempted effects.

relationshipTypes.name: OBSERVES_EFFECT
relationshipTypes.queryJustification: Bind an authoritative outcome observation to the exact attempted effect.

relationshipTypes.name: HAS_DECISION_EVENT
relationshipTypes.queryJustification: Traverse a decision's append-only lifecycle without treating events as current state.

relationshipTypes.name: CORRECTED_BY
relationshipTypes.queryJustification: Trace an approved append-only correction without rewriting decision history.

relationshipTypes.name: DECISION_SUPERSEDES
relationshipTypes.queryJustification: Resolve decision supersession without redefining the core SUPERSEDES relationship.

relationshipTypes.name: PRECEDENT_FOR
relationshipTypes.queryJustification: Return non-authoritative precedent candidates with policy mismatch warnings.

relationshipTypes.name: INFLUENCED_BY
relationshipTypes.queryJustification: Represent reviewed influence without asserting causality.

relationshipTypes.name: CAUSED
relationshipTypes.queryJustification: Represent only a predeclared deterministic and reviewed causal mechanism.
